note: Steve's catalog categories (register R-STV-02, R-STV-03). Applied offline to functions/steve_catalog.json, never at request time. For each product, build the test string as decodedTitle + ' ' + tags.join(' ') + ' ' + handle, test each rule's match as a case-insensitive JS regex (new RegExp(match, 'i')) in the order listed, and give the product the first category that matches; a product that matches none gets the fallback. safety-ppe and solvents-catalysts never reach Steve's results. gelcoat-colour reaches them only when the query says gel coat, colour, color or RAL. instruments-heat ranks below the shop families.
